decision.question: Should Nuke development be paused until March revenue target ($700 MRR) is secured?
decision.recommendation: Yes — defer Nuke Phase 0 work to evenings/weekends. Daytime hours this week must go to IAM follow-ups and closing the Oopuo website blocker.
evidence: Week 13 was ~60% infrastructure vs target 60% revenue — completely inverted
March $700 MRR target with 8 days left and no closed deals
IAM outreach just started — Day 10 follow-ups coming but no pipeline management
Nuke is important but generates $0 in the next 90 days

options.label: Pause Nuke until April
options.description: Focus 100% on IAM outreach + Oopuo leads for remaining March days

options.label: Continue as-is
options.description: Accept March target miss, prioritize architecture
